scope: every generated motion of the large batch and of the official-evaluation batch, one run directory per motion; the generation system itself is not changed by this file (it belongs to another session); python/scripts/motion_contract_check.py validates run directories against it

L1_identity.purpose: who produced the motion and under which switch

required.intervention.json: the switch condition of the run

L1_identity.legacy: PRIMAL: one run directory holds every switch combination; the switch is the factorial file name (ground<g>_reproject<r>_inertialize<i>)

L2_task.purpose: one task format for every method; legacy runs use three formats (joint-position scenario, root goal change of CLoSD / DART, unconditioned continuation of PRIMAL) plus the Kimodo case files
L2_task.legacy: runs before the freeze lack required_new_batch and may use a legacy format; the check records the format, the evaluation maps them from the batch manifest and records the mapping

kinds.root_goal_change: constraints: root goals as {time_seconds, joint: pelvis, position_m (z null)} (legacy goal_start / goal_next / update_seconds)
kinds.continuation: constraints: []; initial_state {history, family, seed} (legacy PRIMAL initial_history / family / initial_seed)
kinds.object_interaction: constraints: object waypoints; object block in L5 (CHOIS)

L3_motion.purpose: the unified motion every evaluator reads

motion.npz.joints: (T, J, 3) float, finite, metres, right-handed Z-up world
motion.npz.metadata_json: units m, axes right-handed Z-up, native_axes, skeleton, native_joint_names

legacy_adapters.kimodo: case directory motion.npz with posed_joints (native Y-up SOMA77, 30 fps; biomech_sources.load)

L4_native.purpose: the full native representation, so that later evaluators (neck, shoulder, native-rotation distribution) can be added without re-generation
L4_native.file: native.npz (new batch); legacy locations are listed per method in method_capability.native_legacy

L5_world.purpose: the method's own conventions and physical quantities

required.floor: height_m in canonical Z, definition, switch variants

method_file.per_entry: value, basis (paper / docs / code file:line, or the reason when nothing is found) and status: cited, inferred_from_code, or 约定 when not found in the method sources (design section 14 item 3)

required.method_world_sha256: sha256 of that file at generation time
required.floor_variant: the floor variant of this run's switches (method_file floor.variants key, or 'default')

objects.object_mass_kg: null when the dataset gives no mass (CHOIS: method_capability.chois.object_mass)

L5_world.legacy: legacy runs have no world.json: the conventions come from config/motion_world/<method>.json and the scored floors from config/evalkit_floor_reference_20261107.json (status legacy)

required.failure: status != success keeps the run directory with failure.json; a failed item is never replaced by another seed

L6_integrity.legacy: manifest.json status and the analysis-level motion_sha256 stand in for integrity.json

method_capability._values: native: in the method output; derived: computed from other outputs (not independent information); absent; to_verify: claimed, not yet checked

chois.objects: native positions / rotations; mass absent (not in the CHOIS outputs and not in the OMOMO data; checked 2026-11-09, see object_mass)

closd.contact_forces_reproducibility: measured 2026-11-09 (develop_logs/test_runs/20261109_closd_rotation_smoke, same seed and event, two runs on one card plus the 10-29 run on another card): joints, rotations_xyzw and dof_positions are bit-identical, contact_forces are not; per frame the summed vertical force differs by up to 854 N (p95 215-291 N), 0.5 s window means by up to 127 N, the whole-run mean by under 1.1 N, foot contact (Fz > 20 N) agrees on 94-96% of frames. No registered metric uses them; any use needs a user decision (the earlier E4 and native-matrix analyses used per-frame values). Effect on those analyses (develop_logs/test_runs/20261109_closd_contact_audit/audit.json, python/scripts/audit_closd_contact_reproducibility.py; 9 identical-input pairs, both entry points; native entry: the 10-24 matrix rows task 0 seed 21 paused, both execution contexts, re-run with the code before and after commit ccb50a3: joints bit-identical in all pairs, per-frame vertical total differs by up to 1007 N): rerun-vs-rerun Pearson r of the vertical total 0.89-0.92 (6 Hz low-pass 0.74-0.81); with independent run noise a noise-free estimate would reach about sqrt of that against one run (0.94-0.96; low-pass 0.86-0.90), so the E4 contact validation (observed median r 0.42 against threshold 0.8; low-pass post hoc 0.65) is not explained by the simulator's non-determinism; the 5 N native-matrix force metrics differ between reruns by at most 0.010 (contact fraction), 0.006 (foot-body motion), 0.010 (nonfoot contact), against execution-context contrasts of +0.016 [-0.007, 0.040], -0.012 [-0.037, 0.012], -0.026 [-0.057, 0.006] (paused; realtime alike)

Native entry after commit ccb50a3: develop_logs/test_runs/20261109_closd_native_rotation/check.json, task 0 seed 21 paused, both contexts: bone vectors constant to < 0.0004 mm over 600 frames, quaternion norms 1 +- 2.4e-7; joints and all motion.npz keys bit-identical to the runs before the change and to the 10-24 archive
